title: A forged terminal results.json in a declared native run can end a run wait as 'files rewritten' before the host publishes its own terminal
outcome: A run wait on a declared native run is not ended as 'not sent; files rewritten' by a results.json an agent wrote before the host recorded the run's own terminal, when the host then publishes its terminal and the record settles.
acceptance: A declared native run whose directory holds an agent-written terminal-looking results.json before the host records its terminal does not mark a run wait for its record until the host's own terminal is recorded, or the wait names the settled record once the host's record settles; covered by a behaviour test.
